content: <thought>Based on the molecular formula (C10H13NO2), DBE (5), presence of an aromatic ring (6 carbons), one carbonyl (ester), and only one CH₃ group (the methyl of the ester), the structure that fits is methyl benzoate with an ethylamine substituent on the ring. The neutral SMILES for this molecule is COC(=O)c1ccc(CCN)cc1.
